prompt: Write R code to normalize RNA-seq count data to CPM (Counts Per Million) using base R. Read the raw count matrix from inputs/counts.tsv with genes as rows and samples as columns, compute each sample's library size, and then compute CPM for each gene as 1e6 * count / library_size. Save the resulting CPM-normalized expression matrix as outputs/cpm.csv, preserving gene row names. As a basic quality check, ensure the file is created and each sample's CPM column sums to roughly one million.
